activity_summary: At dusk you said two days. Let it hold till Thursday. Then Yaxley may have the tooth, and welcome. You did not go, and you did not name any day but Thursday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the memo through a thick jaw, and stopped.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Let it hold till Thursday. Then let Yaxley have it, and welcome.
